name: Opening a limb (base surgical access)
goal: Get retractedskin on a limb so internal procedures are possible

steps.requires: Patient needs analgesia >=1 or unconsciousness >=0.1 (HF.CanPerformSurgeryOn); patient must not be in stasis
no existing incision on the limb; surgery skill 30
surgeryincision >= 99 (grows over time; strength starts at 1+skill/2)

steps.action: Close: clears surgeryincision, clampedbleeding, retractedskin, caviclean + fixes conditions on that limb

notes: Each tool's affliction grows from 1+skill/2; the next step waits until it reaches 99 (95 for suture conditions). Higher skill = faster.

name: Fracture repair (osteosynthesis)

steps.requires: drilledbones (if still present) cleared when surgeryincision >= 95

notes: Non-surgical alternative for arms/legs: antibleeding1 (bandage) then gypsum (plaster cast).

name: Surgical amputation
goal: Cleanly remove a limb (e.g. gangrene) and get a limb item

steps.action: Amputates the limb surgically, gives limb item (rarm/larm/rleg/lleg/headsa) unless already amputated or gangrene >= 15

name: Limb reattachment
goal: Replace an amputated arm/leg with a limb or bionic limb

steps.action: Clears sawedbones and the surgical amputation

notes: Do not suture before attaching - suturing with sawedbones amputates.

name: Organ transplant / swap (liver, heart, lungs, kidneys)

steps.action: Free the organ: <organ>swap = 100 (or <organ>removed if organ is 100% dead)
Insert new organ; returns the old organ item if it was < 90% damaged (kidneys < 45%)

notes: Heart swap sets cardiacarrest 100 (restart with AED/defibrillator); lung swap sets respiratoryarrest 100 (ventilate/BVM). Immunity drives rejection (config NT_organRejection) - give immunosuppressant. Using the organ scalpel a second time while in swap state extracts the organ instead.

name: Organ harvesting
goal: Remove an organ to obtain an organ item

steps.action: Second cut: organ removed, damage set 100, organ item given (condition 100 - damage) if damage < 90

notes: Kills/cripples the donor: heart -> cardiacarrest, lungs -> respiratoryarrest, brain -> neurotrauma +100. Organs are placed into a container held in hand if it has room.

name: Brain transplant
goal: Move a brain into a new body

steps.action: Extract brain item (player detached into item on server)
steps.requires: Head retractedskin; donor neurotrauma < 90 for usable brain

steps.action: Leads to brainremoved if recipient neurotrauma >= 100, otherwise extract

steps.requires: Head retractedskin; brainremoved; surgery 100 for full quality

name: Aortic rupture repair (endovascular)
notes: With config NT_HardmodeAorticRupture, sutures on a retracted torso can also clear aorticrupture.

name: Pneumothorax / tamponade
goal: Relieve and cure collapsed lung or cardiac tamponade

steps.action: Sets pneumothorax, needlec and tamponade to 0
Close (also clears tamponade if config NT_OpenCloseTamponade is off)

name: Arterial cut / internal bleeding / stroke repair

steps.action: Stop arm/leg arterial bleeding in the field
Clears arterialcut, carotidarterialcut, internalbleeding, stroke, tourniqueted on that limb

name: Foreign body removal

steps.action: foreignbody, internaldamage and blunttrauma -3..10 per use

notes: Field alternative: tweezers through a gunshot/explosion wound remove foreignbody only and cause traumaticshock +5.

name: Spinal cord repair
notes: Code does not restrict the limb type.

steps.action: burn reduced by up to 200 on the retracted limb
